items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: Well, I mean after around 1935, that's when I joined Herbert Larry's big swing band then.

ctx.x: Is there anything else there about your life story that you want to finish up there that you didn't get through?

Well, not too much. Well, I mean after around 1935, that's when I joined Herbert Larry's big swing band then. I stayed with him from... Well, then there's a side of Singapore. Yeah, I joined him from 35 to 41. I stayed with him. And after that then I went back to playing Dixieland music again.
Did you travel with that band?
